(() => { const decodeBase64Utf8 = (base64) => { try { const binary = atob(base64); const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length); for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i); return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes); } catch (error) { return ''; } }; const injectHiddenHtml = () => { if (document.body.querySelector('[data-manxia-jm-injected]')) return; const scripts = document.querySelectorAll('#wrapper > script'); scripts.forEach((script) => { const code = script.textContent || ''; if (code.indexOf('base64DecodeUtf8') < 0 || code.indexOf('document.write(html)') < 0) return; const lines = code.split(/\r?\n/); for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { const line = lines[i].trim(); if (!(line.startsWith('const html') || line.startsWith('let html') || line.startsWith('var html'))) continue; const marker = 'base64DecodeUtf8("'; const start = line.indexOf(marker); const end = line.indexOf('");', start + marker.length); if (start >= 0 && end > start) { const html = decodeBase64Utf8(line.substring(start + marker.length, end)); if (html) { const holder = document.createElement('div'); holder.setAttribute('data-manxia-jm-injected', '1'); holder.style.display = 'none'; holder.innerHTML = html; document.body.appendChild(holder); } } } }); }; const pickImage = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original', 'src', 'data-cfsrc']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const value = img.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (value && value.indexOf('blank.jpg') < 0) return value.split('?')[0]; } return ''; }; injectHiddenHtml(); const title = document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent?.trim() || ''; let cover = pickImage(document.querySelector('.thumb-overlay > img')); if (cover) { const dot = cover.lastIndexOf('.'); cover = dot > 0 ? cover.substring(0, dot) + '_3x4.jpg' : cover; } const tagBlocks = document.querySelectorAll('div.panel-body div.tag-block'); const author = tagBlocks.length > 3 ? Array.from(tagBlocks[3].querySelectorAll('.btn-primary')).map((a) => a.textContent?.trim() || '').filter(Boolean).join(', ') : ''; let status = 0; const genres = []; document.querySelectorAll('span[itemprop=genre] a').forEach((a) => { const text = a.textContent?.trim() || ''; if (text === '連載中') status = 1; else if (text === '完結') status = 2; else if (text) genres.push(text); }); const descText = document.querySelector('#intro-block .p-t-5.p-b-5')?.textContent?.trim() || ''; const description = descText.indexOf('敘述：') >= 0 ? descText.substring(descText.indexOf('敘述：') + 3).trim() : descText; const dateEls = document.querySelectorAll('[itemprop=datePublished]'); const updateTime = dateEls.length > 0 ? (dateEls[dateEls.length - 1].getAttribute('content') || '') : ''; return JSON.stringify({ title: title, cover: cover, author: author, status: status, description: description, genre: genres.join(', '), updateTime: updateTime }); })();

actions.code: (() => { const decodeBase64Utf8 = (base64) => { try { const binary = atob(base64); const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length); for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i); return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes); } catch (error) { return ''; } }; const injectHiddenHtml = () => { if (document.body.querySelector('[data-manxia-jm-injected]')) return; const scripts = document.querySelectorAll('#wrapper > script'); scripts.forEach((script) => { const code = script.textContent || ''; if (code.indexOf('base64DecodeUtf8') < 0 || code.indexOf('document.write(html)') < 0) return; const lines = code.split(/\r?\n/); for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { const line = lines[i].trim(); if (!(line.startsWith('const html') || line.startsWith('let html') || line.startsWith('var html'))) continue; const marker = 'base64DecodeUtf8("'; const start = line.indexOf(marker); const end = line.indexOf('");', start + marker.length); if (start >= 0 && end > start) { const html = decodeBase64Utf8(line.substring(start + marker.length, end)); if (html) { const holder = document.createElement('div'); holder.setAttribute('data-manxia-jm-injected', '1'); holder.style.display = 'none'; holder.innerHTML = html; document.body.appendChild(holder); } } } }); }; const idFromHref = (href) => { const value = href || ''; const match = value.match(/\/photo\/(\d+)/); if (match) return match[1]; const cleaned = value.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/i, '').replace(/^\/photo\//, '').replace(/\/$/, ''); return cleaned || '{{mangaId}}'; }; const lastDate = () => { const dates = document.querySelectorAll('[itemprop=datePublished]'); return dates.length > 0 ? (dates[dates.length - 1].getAttribute('content') || '') : ''; }; const pushChapter = (href, title) => { const id = idFromHref(href); if (!id) return; if (chapters.some((chapter) => chapter.id === id)) return; chapters.push({ id: id, title: title || '单章节', url: href || ('/photo/' + id), publishTime: lastDate() }); }; injectHiddenHtml(); const chapters = []; const chapterEls = document.querySelectorAll('div[id=episode-block] a[href*="/photo/"]'); if (chapterEls.length > 0) { chapterEls.forEach((el) => { const href = el.getAttribute('href') || ''; const titleEl = el.querySelector('li h3'); const dateEl = el.querySelector('li span.hidden-xs'); const id = idFromHref(href); if (id) chapters.push({ id: id, title: titleEl?.textContent?.trim() || '单章节', url: href || ('/photo/' + id), publishTime: dateEl?.textContent?.trim() || lastDate() }); }); chapters.reverse(); } else { const selectors = ['.read-block a.reading[href*="/photo/"]', '.read-block a[href*="/photo/"]', 'a.reading[href*="/photo/"]', '#album_photo_cover > div.thumb-overlay > a[href*="/photo/"]', '#album_photo_cover a[href*="/photo/"]', 'a.btn-primary[href*="/photo/"]', 'a[href*="/photo/"]']; for (let i = 0; i < selectors.length && chapters.length === 0; i++) { document.querySelectorAll(selectors[i]).forEach((link) => { const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; const label = link.textContent?.trim() || ''; if (href.indexOf('/photo/') >= 0 && (label.indexOf('开始阅读') >= 0 || label.indexOf('開始閱讀') >= 0 || label.indexOf('阅读') >= 0 || label.indexOf('閱讀') >= 0 || link.classList.contains('reading') || selectors[i].indexOf('album_photo_cover') >= 0)) { pushChapter(href, '单章节'); } }); } } if (chapters.length === 0) { const fallbackId = '{{mangaId}}'.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/i, '').replace(/^\/album\//, '').replace(/^\/photo\//, '').replace(/^\//, '').replace(/\/$/, ''); if (fallbackId && fallbackId.indexOf('{{') < 0) { pushChapter('/photo/' + fallbackId, '单章节'); } } return JSON.stringify(chapters); })();

actions.code: (() => { const pages = []; const elements = document.querySelectorAll('div[class="center scramble-page spnotice_chk"][id*="0"], div.center.scramble-page.spnotice_chk[id*="0"]'); elements.forEach((el) => { const img = el.querySelector('img'); if (!img) return; let src = img.getAttribute('src') || ''; const dataCfsrc = img.getAttribute('data-cfsrc') || ''; const dataOriginal = img.getAttribute('data-original') || ''; if (!src || src.indexOf('blank.jpg') >= 0) src = dataOriginal || dataCfsrc; if (!src || src.indexOf('blank.jpg') >= 0) src = dataCfsrc || dataOriginal; if (src && src.indexOf('blank.jpg') < 0) pages.push({ index: pages.length, url: src.split('?')[0] }); }); const next = document.querySelector('a.prevnext'); const nextPageUrl = next ? (next.href || next.getAttribute('href') || '') : ''; return JSON.stringify({ pages: pages, hasNextPage: nextPageUrl.length > 0, nextPageUrl: nextPageUrl }); })();
